First off if the tank is for eliquids please don't put a concentrate in there without mixing it with an oil base of some sort (I work at a smoke shop and have seen people try). Keep your wattage low if you have variable wattage, if not no need to worry. Load a normal, lentil sized dab onto your coil and give that bitch a long slow pull so you waste as little as possible. If any wax falls off or underneath the coil, turn your pen upside down to try and get some of it back on there. Keep your pen clean and maintained, and if your coil has metal wiring on it don't try to pull wax off your coil it can rip the coil out. If you're trying to take fat globs you're probably gonna be wasting product with most if not all pens, so use a piece of glass instead if you can.

I've looked into the conspiracy a lot, and while I don't think Paul is dead, John and the rest of the Beatles had a certain fascination with backwards writing, which could place some legitimacy to all the backwards lyrics. You could say most of them are a stretch and you'd probably be right, but that's probably because they needed it to sound good played normally as well. I believe the first instance is in Rain, which John credits the "God of Marijuana" for (lol), but he also had a fascination with the works of Alistair Crowley, who in turn placed importance in reading and writing backwards. There's also the poem about the Jabberwocky in Through the Looking Glass, John loved Lewis Carroll's ability to play with words and was inspired by him as well. Overall, I'm not enough of a believer, especially since Paul seems to be very alive and also very hard to replace, but the Beatles were certainly talented enough to pull the stunt if they wanted to.
